changing a line: name, about, nights, day; text only for a line you wrote down yourself
verb let_in: entryId (a line from the door joins the book)
verb new_code: the door gets a new link and the old one stops working
removing a line: anyone who lives here. That is also how a line from the door is turned away.
entries list: filter waiting (only lines that wait for a yes)

lived_here.name: Everyone who's lived here
guide: settings: none
entry resident (what the flat writes about someone who is or was in the circle; one per person, adding again changes it): memberId, fromYear, untilYear, note
entry before (people who lived here before the app): name, count (how many people; left out: 1), fromYear, untilYear, note
entry handed_on: thingId (something of this circle that you can see)

kitty.name: The kitty
guide: settings: eachCents (what each pays in a month, whole cents; left out: 1000), currency (left out: EUR), payInDay (1 to 28; left out: 1)
entry in: cents (left out: eachCents), day (left out: today). Your own paying in.
entry out: what (what was bought), cents, day (left out: today), mediaId (a photo of the receipt), itemIds (usual things this bought: they stop running low)
entry item: name (one of the flat's usual things)
verb low: itemId, low (true or false; left out: true)
entries list: every line there ever was, newest first; kind in or out

fairer_split.name: A fairer split
guide: settings: none

entry split: name, group (rent, bills, kitty or other; left out: bills), repeats (left out: true for rent and kitty), from and to (the days a bill is for; needed for nights), payerMemberId (who paid a bill), currency, and its first proposal: way, totalCents, shared, parts

a proposal's fields: way (equal, room, nights, use or own), totalCents, shared (square metres of shared space, for room), parts ([{memberId, measure, note, cents}]: measure is square metres, nights at home or units used; nights left out are counted from Heads-up; cents for every part sets the shares by hand and has to add up to the total; parts left out: everyone)
verb propose: splitId and a proposal's fields (what is left out stays as it was). Everyone is asked again.
verb agree: proposalId
verb paid: splitId, paid (true or false; left out: true), memberId (left out: you; whoever paid the bill may tick for others)
changing a split entry: name, group, payerMemberId. Removing: a proposal by whoever proposed it; a split only while nobody agreed to it.

heads_up.name: Heads-up
guide: settings: standing (a line that always stands under the notices), standingNote
entry notice: text, detail (a few words more), what (away, guests or note; left out: note), from (the day it starts), until (the day it ends). Time away needs both days.
verb answer: noticeId, says (fine or talk; null takes your answer back), text (a few words with it)
entries list: kind notice gives every notice there ever was, newest first

find_date.name: When can everyone?
guide: settings: from and to (the days offered, 62 at most; left out: the three weeks from today)
verb tap: day, free (true or false; left out: true). Your own day.
verb cant: cant (true or false; left out: true). None of the days work for you.
verb opened: says you have looked at it (the app sends it when the board is opened)
verb nudge: memberId (someone who hasn't answered; once a day)
verb set: day (left out: the best day), time (HH:mm; left out: all day), timeZone (left out: UTC). It becomes an event with everyone on it.
verb new_link: the link for people without the app is replaced, and the old one stops working
removing an entry: an answer that came by link, by anyone who may change the board

secret_santa.name: Secret Santa
guide: settings: budgetCents (0 for no limit), currency, swapOn (a date), swapAt (words), swapThingId (something of the circle to open from the swap's row)
entry name: memberId (someone with their own sign-in). Before the draw only; a new board starts with everyone in the hat.
entry apart: memberId, otherMemberId, why. Two people who can't draw each other. Before the draw only.
entry wish: text. Your own wish list: you and whoever drew you read it.
verb draw: draws the names. Each person is shown only the one they drew.
verb undo_draw: everyone draws again. Only while nobody has their present.
verb got_it: got (true or false; left out: true). Seen by nobody else.

where_next.name: Where next?
guide: settings: when (words: Spring 2027), closesOn (the last day to vote; left out: until everyone has)
entry idea: name, days, costCents (roughly, each), currency, note, mediaId (a photo upload). While the vote is open.
verb vote: ideaId (your one vote; voting again moves it). The vote closes when everyone has voted.
verb unvote: takes your vote back, while the vote is open
verb close: closes the vote early
verb make_trip: gives the winner a folder and a page in Notes, to plan in

dictionary.name: The dictionary
guide: settings: none
entry word: word, meaning, part (verb, noun…), coinedByMemberId (or coinedByName; left out: you), origin (where it came from), firstRecorded (a date), seeAlso, mediaId (a photo upload)
entries list: q (words), member (who coined it)

predictions.name: Predictions
guide: settings: opensOn (a date after today), occasion (words: the reunion)
entry prediction: aboutMemberId, text, seal (left out: true; false keeps it a draft only you see). One about each of the others. Changing: text, seal, while it is your own draft.
verb seal: entryId (your own draft; left out: all your drafts)
verb mark: predictionId, right (true, false, or null to take it back). From the day they open.

awards.name: The awards
guide: settings: none
entry award: name, emoji. A category for this year.
entry nominee: awardId, memberId, what (what for), mediaId (a photo upload). While the award is open.
verb vote: nomineeId (your one vote for that award; voting again moves it). The award is decided when everyone has voted.
verb unvote: awardId
verb decide: awardId (closes its vote early)
show: a year, to see that year's awards. Left out: this year.

walk_together.name: A goal you walk together
guide: settings: from and to (the names of the two places), unit (km or steps; left out: km), goal (how far it is: metres for km, steps for steps)
entry walk: amount (metres on a board in km, steps on a board in steps), day (left out: today). Your own walks only.
entry stop: name, at (how far along the way, in the same unit as the goal)
